title: Editor E0 task 12b, wiring slice: with the Space switch on, the owner page and the rail run on nodes
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 on 2026-10-20 (id outside the Editor LIVE-1000..1009 block, which is spent). OwnerSpaceLayoutPreview renders LiveNodeGrid, seeded by ownerNodeLayout (lib/entity-blocks/node-seed.ts: the stored document read as nodes, data blocks filled with effective content, content blocks keeping their own bag), when renderPathEnabled('space_profile'). getSpaceLayoutRailData carries nodeLayout only in that case, and SpacePageBuilderSwitch mounts NodePageBuilder when the rail data carries one, else the type-keyed builder. Switch off: nothing changes. Honest gap before the switch can be turned on: the /manage/layout canvas editor (space-canvas-editor) and the Spotlight still write the type-keyed document, which the LIVE-887 guard refuses once a Space stores nodes.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const rd=f=>fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');const bad=[];const p=rd('components/spaces/owner-space-layout-preview.tsx');if(!p.includes(\"renderPathEnabled('space_profile')\")||!p.includes('LiveNodeGrid'))bad.push('preview does not choose the node grid behind the switch');if(!rd('components/entity-blocks/space-page-builder-switch.tsx').includes('effective?.nodeLayout'))bad.push('rail does not choose the builder by the data');if(!rd('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/rail-getters.ts').includes(\"renderPathEnabled('space_profile')\"))bad.push('rail data ignores the switch');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1050: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when the preview, the rail data or the builder switch stops following render_path_space_profile. Behavior is space-page-builder-switch.test.tsx and node-seed.test.ts.
